competition.title: VIT CODE APEX 3.0
competition.details:
VIT Code_Apex 3.0

Organised by AISF – Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT), Pune

VIT Code_Apex 3.0 is the third edition of our national-level flagship hackathon, bringing together passionate developers, designers, innovators, and problem-solvers from across India to build impactful solutions to real-world challenges.

The hackathon provides participants with an opportunity to showcase their technical skills, creativity, and problem-solving abilities while competing at a national level and interacting with a community of like-minded innovators.

About the Opportunity

Why Participate in VIT Code_Apex 3.0?

  • Solve real-world, industry-relevant challenges
  • Build innovative and scalable solutions
  • Compete with talented students across India
  • Showcase your technical & problem-solving skills
  • Gain industry-oriented experience
  • Win exciting prizes, goodies & recognition

Technology Domains

AI/ML • Web & Backend • Blockchain & Web3 • Cloud Computing • Data Science • Cybersecurity • IoT • Emerging Technologies

Tracks

VIT Code_Apex 3.0 features four exciting tracks, offering participants different avenues to showcase their innovation and technical expertise.

Track 1 – Problem Statement Powered by Emerson + More Coming Soon

Three Problem Statements have been released under Track 1 by Emerson, with more Problem Statements to be announced shortly.

Currently Available:

  • Project UNTANGLE — AI-based P&ID to simplified process sketch Project_UNTANGLE_Problem_Statem…
  • Project IO SIGNAL SUDOKU — AI-powered DeltaV I/O allocation and rule-based optimization Project_IO_Signal_Sudoku_Proble…
  • Project EAGLE EYE — AI vision-based control cabinet quality inspection

The description of the problem statement is attached in the attachment section below.

Track 2 – AI-Based Problem Statements Powered by iMocha

Problem Statements:

  • 01 Vibe Coding — AI-era coding assessment with AI-assisted development, candidate journey tracking, and skill reporting.
  • 02 Autonomous AI QA Engineer — AI agent that explores web applications, generates and runs tests, and reports bugs with evidence.
  • 03 Skill Passport — AI-powered verified skill profile built from real work, with evidence-based skills, role matching, and personalised learning paths.
  • 04 AI Job Simulator — AI-powered workplace simulation where users practise real-world scenarios and receive evidence-based feedback.
  • 05 Codebase Mentor — AI mentor that helps developers understand unfamiliar codebases through grounded answers, architecture overviews, and guided onboarding.

The description of the problem statement is attached in the attachment section below.

Track 3 – Open Innovation

Open Now

Track 3 is the Open Innovation Track, currently open for registrations.

Track 4 – Technology for Social Impact Powered by UST

Three AI/ML Problem Statements are currently available under Track 4:

  • AI-Based Predictive Cold-Storage Excursion & Early-Warning System — predicts upcoming temperature excursions using historical/simulated sensor and operating data.
  • AI-Based Indoor Positioning with Sparse Infrastructure and Noisy Measurements — estimates the 2D position of a moving target despite limited reference points, noise, missing measurements and non-line-of-sight errors.
  • AI-Based Sensor Trust, Drift and False-Alarm Detection — distinguishes genuine environmental events from sensor faults, drift, spikes and unreliable measurements.

The description of the problem statement is attached in the attachment section below.

Participants are free to identify a meaningful problem and develop an innovative, technology-driven solution of their choice. Solutions will be evaluated based on factors such as innovation, technical implementation, feasibility, scalability, and potential real-world impact.

Participants are encouraged to think beyond conventional solutions and build ideas that create meaningful value.

Competition Structure

VIT Code_Apex 3.0 will be conducted through multiple stages:

Round 1: Online Screening

10th – 11th October 2026

Teams will submit their proposed solutions as per the submission guidelines. The submissions will be evaluated based on problem understanding, innovation, technical approach, feasibility, and potential impact.

Round 1 Results

12th October 2026

Shortlisted teams will be announced and will proceed to the next stage.

Round 2: Online Evaluation

15th – 18th October 2026

Shortlisted teams will present their solutions before the evaluation panel and explain their approach, implementation strategy, feasibility, and expected impact.

Round 2 Results

19th October 2026

The final shortlisted teams will be announced for the offline grand finale.

Grand Finale

24th October 2026 | VIT Pune

The final round will be conducted offline at Vishwakarma Institute of Technology, Pune, where shortlisted teams will demonstrate and present their final solutions before the jury.

Rewards & Prizes

Overall Prize Pool: ₹2,00,000

  • 1st Prize – ₹50,000
  • 2nd Prize – ₹30,000
  • 3rd Prize – ₹20,000

In addition to the overall prizes, track-wise winners will also be recognised.

Track-wise Rewards

Winners from each track will receive:

  • ₹2,000 cash prize
  • Exciting goodies

This gives participants multiple opportunities to win and be recognised for their innovation and technical excellence.

Goodies for All Participants

Every participant will receive exclusive goodies as a token of appreciation for being part of VIT Code_Apex 3.0.

 

Featured Sponsor – Verzii

We are excited to have Verzii as a sponsor for VIT Code_Apex 3.0.

All participants are requested to download the Verzii app using the official link below and explore the platform as part of the hackathon experience.

›  DOWNLOAD VERZII

HOW TO JOIN THE VIT CODE_APEX 3.0 COMMUNITY:

1. Download and install the Verzii app using the link provided above.

2. Sign up or log in to your Verzii account.

3. Search for “AISF” or “Artificial Intelligence Students’ Forum”.

4. Join the AISF community.

5. Go to the “Community” tab.

6. Find the “VIT Code_Apex 3.0” community.

7. Join the VIT Code_Apex 3.0 community.

All important hackathon-related updates, announcements, and information will be shared through the VIT Code_Apex 3.0 community on Verzii.

Download Verzii and stay connected with VIT Code_Apex 3.0 throughout the hackathon.

 

Eligibility & Team Participation

  • Open to students across India
  • Participation is in teams
  • Participants from different colleges can participate
  • Team size will be as specified in the registration guidelines

Important Dates

Event Date
Registration Closes 9th October 2026
Round 1 10th – 11th October 2026
Round 1 Results 12th October 2026
Round 2 15th – 18th October 2026
Round 2 Results 19th October 2026
Grand Finale 24th October 2026

Join VIT Code_Apex 3.0

Choose your track, bring your ideas to life, and compete with innovators from across the country.

With ₹1,00,000 in overall cash prizes, track-wise rewards, exciting goodies for every participant, and an opportunity to build solutions that matter, VIT Code_Apex 3.0 is your platform to Compete. Innovate. Build.
